law002_pi_a_admissibility_projection_law.name: Pi_A Admissibility Projection Law
law002_pi_a_admissibility_projection_law.purpose: Define a first explicit law-program candidate for Π_A as bounded admissibility projection.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Given a candidate update y_alpha, Π_A maps y_alpha into the admissible continuation window A_alpha when possible, while preserving boundary cases and failure modes when projection is undefined, multi-valued, or unstable.
candidate_law_statement.symbolic_candidate: Π_{A_α}(y_α) := { z_α ∈ A_α : d_A(z_α, y_α) = inf_{u∈A_α} d_A(u, y_α) }
candidate_law_statement.idempotence_candidate: Π_{A_α}(Π_{A_α}(y_α)) = Π_{A_α}(y_α), when Π_{A_α}(y_α) is defined and stable
candidate_law_statement.important_note: This is a candidate projection law, not a proof that projection is unique, globally defined, smooth, or physically instantiated.
